panels.sample_scope: Supplementary Fig. 14 | Pressure-interval contributions to inward and outward water-vapour exchange. a–c, Gross inward, gross outward and net inward exchange, respectively. Each matrix gives temporary- and final-departure means and their paired temporary-minus-final contrast for the four native pressure intervals spanning 500–925 hPa. All cells use the same 80 cyclones, moving 300 km boundary and 0–24 h window. Values are masses integrated within each interval (10¹² kg); the intervals have unequal widths and are not a continuous pressure profile. All three matrices share a zero-centred colour scale in 10¹² kg. Net inward exchange equals gross inward minus gross outward exchange. Both classes have net outward point means at 500–600 hPa despite positive layer-integrated mean net input. Table S6g2 gives all 36 estimates and ordinary 95% paired-SID percentiles from 2,000 resamples.
